# Wikipedia

> > Wikipedia is the free online encyclopedia founded by Jimmy Wales and Larry Sanger, operated by the Wikimedia Foundation, covering millions of topics from Greek mythology to technology.

Wikipedia is a multilingual, collaboratively edited online encyclopedia that serves as one of the world's largest reference resources. The English Wikipedia is the largest language edition, containing articles on virtually every topic imaginable.
